invariants.rule: The same exact-version selections, owner-resolution receipts, ordering authority and runtime form context produce the same ordered species contributions and projection digest.
Runtime species projection consumes exact-version SpeciesDefinition, lineage, form, adaptation and adjudication references; current/latest substitution is never implicit.

Projection reads CharacterSpeciesSelection history and may emit current contributions/receipts, but cannot rewrite base species, lineage, choices, adjudications, migration receipts or historical grant evidence.
Active form state is an explicit final overlay using MVPS-09 retention/replacement semantics; temporary state never becomes replacement source truth and reversal uses recorded pre-transform state.

Every active, suppressed, conditional or owner-deferred species contribution carries canonical record identity, source layer/ref/version and provenance; character-visible grant receipts retain recoverable source and reason.

Duplicate, stacking, suppression and replacement semantics remain with shared mechanic/rules owners; MVPS-13 preserves all source contributions and consumes their resolution receipt rather than choosing a local winner.

Incomplete, invalid, unresolved or migration-required current selections do not silently become playable runtime projections; projection is blocked or restricted to an explicit historical-read context.

MVPS-13 emits a species contribution fragment and compatible grant receipts for the shared Character projection/persistence owners; it does not create a generic Character projection, persistence, equipment, resource, environment or effect engine.

enforcement.ci_step: Run MVPS-13 runtime projection grant-receipt regressions
